title: Mosquitoes carry yellow fever
summary: Cuban physician Carlos Finlay proposed in 1881 that a mosquito, now known as Aedes aegypti, carries yellow fever from sick to healthy people.
why: The key to controlling yellow fever.

unsung.contribution: First proposed that mosquitoes transmit yellow fever, backing it with years of evidence.
unsung.recognition: Ridiculed at the 1881 conference; history books gave Walter Reed much of the credit, though Reed himself credited Finlay.
